description: Adam's tavern interior: use as title screen background and settlement conversation backdrop (Mate)

updates.appendNotes: ART AVAILABLE (Nov 12): Adam made a tavern interior scene. Use it as the title screen background (scale with nearest-neighbour so the pixels stay crisp, darken it slightly so the menu stays readable). It is a scene image, not a map tile.

ART AVAILABLE (Nov 12): Adam's tavern interior can be the backdrop behind conversations that happen in a settlement/tavern (show it faintly behind the chat panel, or as a header image when talking to an NPC there). Interiors are not playable maps in the MVP, so this is decoration only.
